# langsmith_evaluator (Data Source)

Looks up a LangSmith evaluator by ID. The nested `code_evaluator` / `llm_evaluator` payloads are surfaced as JSON-encoded strings for downstream consumption.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "langsmith_evaluator" "existing" {
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `code_evaluator_json` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `llm_evaluator_json` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `tenant_id` (String)
- `type` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
